segments.name: Oil and natural gas development, exploration and production
segments.description: Develops and produces oil and natural gas, with associated liquids and helium, from properties in the United States for processors and purchasers.
segments.evidence: The Company only has one reportable operating segment, which is oil and natural gas development, exploration and production in the United States.

revenueModel.text: The Company sells oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids to processors and other third parties under index-priced contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: The oil and natural gas were typically sold in an unprocessed state to processors and other third parties for processing and sale to customers.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company rebranded and realigned its primary business focus onto digital infrastructure and data center development.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, we rebranded as New Era Energy & Digital, Inc. and subsequently realigned our primary business focus on digital infrastructure and data center development.

changes.text: The Company disposed of its oil properties in 2024, and had no oil sales during 2025.
changes.evidence: During 2025, the Company did not have any oil sales as it disposed of its oil properties in 2024.
